name: MSP_FC_VERSION

payload_layout.note: Read-only reply: three u8 calendar-version values followed by a one-byte string length and the version-string bytes. The final version string 2025.12.1 is nine bytes, making this tagged reply 13 bytes total. Official commit 21eba179396e240ccc548fb63c18e23ddf628cf3 introduced the extra length-prefixed version string.

verification.method: Clean-room review of the pinned official source only. The project does not parse or support this extended layout and this record does not claim hardware observation.

licensing.note: Interface layout facts were read from a published pinned source and restated in original prose. No upstream code, comments, fixtures, tables, tests, or error strings were copied.

notes: Compatibility research only. The strict API-1.46 three-byte parser remains unchanged.
